userStories.notes: Created packages/canvas/src/nodes/component-runtime.tsx exporting ComponentRuntime({ spec, nodeId, apiBaseUrl='/api', flowId }). Internal state via useReducer with set + merge actions; resolveValue handles $state (looks up state[path]), $action (returns a callable that dispatches by name), and $cond/$then/$else (recursively resolves both arms then returns the matching one). dispatch async function: set-kind resolves $param refs against payload + $state refs against current state then dispatchState({kind:'set'}); script-kind POSTs to ${apiBaseUrl}/flows/${flowId}/nodes/${nodeId}/actions/${name} with JSON payload, on res.ok parses body and dispatchState({kind:'merge'}), on !res.ok stores text under /__errors/<name>, on catch stores message under /__errors/<name>. renderElement recurses through spec.elements via spec.root, mounts componentRegistry.components[el.type] with resolved props + recursively-rendered children.
